name: Tempeh (Plain)
siboNotes: Well-tolerated in SIBO due to fermentation process that reduces FODMAPs. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Steam for 10-15 minutes before cooking to reduce bitterness
Slice thin and pan-fry for crispy texture
Marinate in low-FODMAP sauces for enhanced flavor
Crumble into stir-fries as a ground meat substitute
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
